changes.description: Independent audit of Codex commit 3704b32 (CHG-20261019-003) against the Director's D13 brief, the D13 clarification recorded 2026-10-19T17:45:54.053Z and D14. Reviewed the product diff from cda3b54: P060 (two opening validMoves additions, ledger and provenance); the bridge's timeout, forfeit and raised-count paths and its rollback; adapter logical revisions, transcript3/checkpoint2 replay and viewer endReason; clock-store concession admission at the deadline; the transition worker; contracts viewer2/clock2/live4 with retained legacy codecs; migration 0006; the match-client helpers; the Lab facade; and the decision register, ADR0016 and runbook updates. Verified rule 2.3.3.4 in both cached rulebooks against their recorded SHA-256 hashes.

RUN-20261020-004 engine probe: 60 random games (9,243 commands; 1,645 of 1,648 accepted states equal to the raw runtime, the other 3 late opening decisions turned into timeout losses with equal state apart from the ending); 60 main-game timeouts equal the engine's own late pass in full state and events; limits 1-5 end on the limit-th timeout, consecutive or not; opening timeouts at all 3 steps under limits 1/3/10; 13 opening concession cases; forfeitGame refused SERVER_ONLY/MOVE_FORBIDDEN; controls never count; concession refused CLOCK_PAUSED while paused; replay of both endings verifies and 8 tampered archives are rejected. RUN-20261020-005/006 service probe on the test database with simulated UTC: opening and main-game timeout endings with one system receipt; a ten-minute outage pauses without charge or count and an audited resume keeps count 0; forged audits refused; player forfeitGame rejected/forbidden; waiting opening concessions unreserved and fenced; RUN006's 24 genuine deadline races (two processes' sweeps, both concessions, the active move) each end with exactly one result (15 timeout, 9 concession). RUN005's race section was degenerate because a warm-up tick fired the timeout first; it is kept as recorded. RUN-20261020-007 contract probe: viewer2/clock2/live4 invariants, legacy codec separation, pending3, forfeit intent refusal and client warning text.

Finding 1 (Important): 3704b32 fails pnpm lint with three no-useless-assignment errors in docs/validation/inputs/play04-d13-closure.mjs, the executed RUN-20261019-038 input added after RUN-20261019-037 (RUN-20261020-002). The source fingerprint excludes docs/ while ESLint lints that file, so RUN037's matching fingerprint did not cover it. Repaired with a one-file rule override in eslint.config.mjs, keeping the executed input byte-identical; every verified feature is re-bound to RUN-20261020-008 and RUN-20261020-009 at the new fingerprint.

RUN-20261020-008 typecheck, lint and full workspace tests passed (369 Node, 24 Python, upstream 406 with 1 inherited skip, 2 injection). RUN-20261020-009 isolated pipeline passed all 14 stages in 528 s with exact timing, reproducing every Codex count: 85 database/storage/live, 13 Chromium, 2 general + 12 P060 Lab workers. RUN-20261020-003 (pipeline with the override before evidence re-binding) failed docs:check as expected.

Recorded the audit in docs/validation/play-04.md with finding 2 (Minor, Director decision: a concession is refused while the clock is paused, for either player and every pause reason), confirmations, observations and runs; dated notes in ADR0016 and the game-clocks runbook; F-MATCH-CLOCKS entries; PLAY-04 backlog status; dated audit lines in AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md; handoff.
